Q: Notification service extension not called on flutter iOS A:

I faced with the same problem. Turns out the "Embed Foundation Extensions" must be placed on top of the "Run scripts" phases in the "Build Phases" tab (Target > Runner > Build Phases), per Flutter's guide: https://docs.flutter.dev/platform-integration/ios/app-extensions#add-extension

Q: Get date of when user in Azure Active Directory was disabled A:

The attribute whenChanged doesn't tell you when a account got disabled, it only tells you when the last write operation to this object did happen, nothing more.

For AD (EventId 4725) as well as AzureAd you have to ask the log to answer this question:

#add UPN here
$upn = [userPirncipalName]
Get-MgAuditLogDirectoryAudit -Filter "ActivityDisplayName eq 'Disable account' and TargetResources/any(t:t/UserPrincipalName eq '$upn')"

Note: Azure Ad keeps the log only for 30 days. Also there is no guarantee by when AzureAd writes operations to the AuditLog - they only say in 95% of the cases the information may be available within 2 minutes. Values in the filter = case sensitive.

Q: Error - expected <block end>, but found '<scalar>' A:

The best way to put scalars that have both single and double quotes themselves into YAML is by using a block style scalars. That is a scalar that is indicated by the | or > character. In the block style (|) none of the characters in the scalar are interpreted, even newlines are newlines:

shell: |-
    {{ scrub_command }} -c \"UPDATE project_record SET meta=jsonb_set(meta, '{"email"}', concat('"', meta->>'email', '.not"')::jsonb) WHERE meta->>'email' IS NOT NULL AND meta->>'email' NOT ILIKE '%@email.somethingelse.com' AND meta->>'email' NOT ILIKE '%@something.com';\"

In folded style single newlines are replaced by a space so you can make things a bit more readable:

shell: >-
    {{ scrub_command }} -c \"UPDATE project_record 
    SET meta=jsonb_set(meta, '{"email"}', concat('"', meta->>'email', '.not"')::jsonb)
     WHERE meta->>'email' IS NOT NULL AND meta->>'email' NOT ILIKE '%@email.somethingelse.com' AND meta->>'email'
     NOT ILIKE '%@something.com';\"

In both the second line should be exactly (including backslashes that have no special meaning in these block style YAML scalars, but of course do for the shell that executes the string loaded from the scalar).

The - after | resp. > is necessary to get rid of the trailing newline.

Q: Connection Information for Oracle SQL Developer database A:

The reason why you are getting the error is because you have not specified service name or SID as it doesn't know to which instance it should connect.

I suppose you are using one of the latest versions of SQL Developer available for download.

Right click connections and choose New Connection from context menu, you will get a window like one is pasted below, there you enter connection details and do not forget to enter either service name or SID.

Q: How do you guys create DTOs? A:

What others mentioned + I prefer Mapperly to Automapper. It is faster because it doesnt use reflection and not-commercialized in comparison to Automapper. And Mapperly seems to be more actively maintained in comparison to Mapster. Reason for us to use mappers instead of manual mappings is that most properties in our Entities -> DTOs are 1:1 named and when you introduce a new one mapper will map that property automatically. If the names are changed you either get a warning (Mapperly) or you can write a test if all mappings are done (AutoMapper.AssertConfigurationIsValid).

Even when I am a heavy AI user I dont like the "AI will write it for you"....it certainly can, but when I switch to manual code-edit I dont want to think about this...that I have to write that one newly added property into several classes.
